passage:
The inspector's car was already turning into the clinic lane, and the power had been off since noon. Sangeeta Ma'am pushed the vaccine fridge log at Lakshmi. 'Three days are blank. Just fill in the usual reading with last week's dates. Quickly.'
Lakshmi's heart hammered. She was eleven days into the job.
'Ma'am, I can't write readings I didn't take,' she said. 'If the fridge was off, the inspector needs to know, for the vaccines' sake.'
'We'll look careless.'
'We can write today's reading now and add a note that the entries were missed and why. And I'll set a phone reminder so it doesn't happen again.'
Sangeeta Ma'am stared at her, then at the car door slamming outside. 'Fine. Write the note. Fast.'
Lakshmi wrote it in her neatest hand, fingers barely shaking.

qa.q: How many days of the log were blank?
What was Lakshmi feeling as she refused?
qa.a: Her heart hammered because she was new and nervous about refusing a senior, but she was clear she couldn't write readings she hadn't taken.

qa.q: What made Lakshmi's refusal work under pressure?
qa.a: She gave one simple reason and offered an honest alternative, today's reading plus a note and a reminder, so her senior had a quick way forward without backdating.

qa.q: What might Sangeeta Ma'am be feeling as the inspector's car door slams?
qa.a: She is likely anxious about looking careless and irritated at first, but accepts the note because it is honest, quick and she has little time.

grounding: It shows a new hire refusing to backdate a log under time pressure, giving a simple reason and offering an honest alternative.

passage:
Kavitha had been at the Chennai design office for three weeks when Ayesha, the senior engineer, slid a site inspection form across her desk.
'Sign this and date it Friday. The client's asking why it's late.'
'Did someone inspect the scaffolding on Friday?'
Ayesha sighed. 'It's the same scaffolding it was on Thursday. It's a formality.'
Kavitha's pulse jumped, but her voice stayed even. 'I can't put a date on something I didn't see. But I can go to the site at seven tomorrow, check it properly and sign it with tomorrow's date. I'll email the client tonight that it's scheduled.'
Ayesha looked at her for a long moment. 'You'll really go at seven?'
'I'll send you a photo from the gate.'
Ayesha took the form back. 'Fine. Seven.'

qa.q: What date did Ayesha want on the form?
What was Kavitha feeling when answering Ayesha?
qa.a: Kavitha's pulse jumped with nerves at refusing a senior, but the voice stayed even and firm about not signing for something unseen.

qa.q: Why is refusing at this first request easier than refusing later?
qa.a: Declining now, with a clear reason and an honest plan, sets Kavitha's line before the shortcut becomes a habit that would be harder to break.

qa.q: How might Ayesha see the new hire after this exchange?
qa.a: Ayesha may be surprised and a little annoyed, but also sees that Kavitha is reliable and is solving the client's problem honestly.

grounding: It shows a new engineer declining to backdate an inspection form, stating the reason plainly and offering a compliant alternative.
